field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every Exp5765 field exists before a reviewer trusts the final NFR-01 claim or retirement.
field_principles.status: Bare terminal state lets gates distinguish complete from blocked without parsing prose.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records provenance, release-build, host-stability, warmup, restart, and manifest gates before timing starts.
field_principles.spec_refs: Binds the artifact to REQ-SAMPLE-5765 and SCENARIO-SAMPLE-5765.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_hashes: Pins Exp5751, Exp5739, and Exp5764 so final timing cannot drift from repaired and optimized provenance.
field_principles.source_hashes: Hashes optimized source bytes used by the final release benchmark.
field_principles.release_binary_hashes: Hashes the local release extension artifacts used by the Rust/PyO3 path.
field_principles.host_receipts: Authenticates CPU, governor, thread, memory, disk, and competing-load observations.
field_principles.affinity_receipt: Records fixed CPU placement used for warmup and paired timing.
field_principles.benchmark_manifest: Freezes sizes, batches, seeds, budgets, paths, tolerances, outlier policy, bootstrap method, and claim rule before timing.
field_principles.benchmark_manifest_hash: Content-addresses the preregistered manifest independently of timing results.
field_principles.cell_sizes: Makes the 48/96/192 plus larger feasible final panel explicit.
field_principles.paired_batches_per_cell: Proves each qualified size has at least thirty paired measured batches after warmup.
field_principles.raw_timing_receipts: Preserves raw interleaved per-batch end-to-end timing and phase receipts before summaries.
field_principles.warmup_receipts: Shows warmup stability before science rows enter the benchmark.
field_principles.quality_metrics_by_cell: Reports energy, feasibility, acceptance, retained count, ESS, and autocorrelation diagnostics before speed claims.
field_principles.semantic_parity_by_cell: Proves exact semantic parity where exactness applies.
field_principles.restart_parity_by_cell: Proves checkpoint and restart parity remained repaired during timing.
field_principles.distributional_parity_by_cell: Reports distributional diagnostics so speed cannot hide wrong samples.
field_principles.fallback_equivalence: Proves the Python exact fallback and Rust production path remain matched.
field_principles.production_backend_reachable: Proves the explicit one_axis_rust SamplerBackend reached the optimized release path.
field_principles.exclusion_manifest: Reports every excluded pair with a preregistered reason instead of silently filtering timing.
field_principles.speedup_median_by_size: Preserves honest measured paired speedup medians by size.
field_principles.speedup_lcb_by_size: Applies the paired bootstrap lower bound used by the 10x claim rule.
field_principles.speedup_ucb_by_size: Preserves the paired bootstrap upper bound for uncertainty review.
field_principles.consecutive_larger_size_rule_passed: Bare gate proves two consecutive larger sizes have lower confidence bound >=10.0.
field_principles.matched_quality_gate_passed: Bare gate proves all parity and quality checks passed before any NFR-01 claim.
field_principles.rust_10x_claimed: Bare true is allowed only under the final consecutive larger-size confidence rule.
field_principles.rust_10x_retired: Bare true retires only this allocation-free one-axis PyO3 technique after a repeated null.
field_principles.remaining_bottleneck: Names the measured bottleneck left after allocation reduction when the 10x rule fails.
field_principles.nfr01_status: States whether PRD NFR-01 is qualified, retired for this technique, or blocked.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents local CPU software timing from becoming a hardware claim.
field_principles.two_axis_exchange_reopened: Bare false keeps retired two-axis exchange out of scope.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares local Rust/PyO3 CPU release matched benchmarking, not LLM, GPU, FPGA, or TSU inference.
field_principles.random_seeds: Records the paired seed schedule for replay.
field_principles.duration_s: Records real wall-clock artifact construction time for fabrication review.
field_principles.test_commands: Lists the verification commands run for the final benchmark.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the complete artifact after blanking the self-checksum field.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Starts complete: or blocked: and states whether NFR-01 was claimed, retired for this technique, or blocked.
